analysis:
Examined EngineV2Factory+Production.swift (base and head) and LaunchAgent.swift (patch). The factory change adds a read-only `prefillGeometry: PrefillGeometry?` field to ProductionBuild. It is populated from the already-resolved schedulerConfig at head line 402 and passed through the init at lines 138 and 152, with a nil default. This is metadata only. It does not alter admission, backend selection, memory-owner binding, prefix-cache/completePrefixCache binding, or the GLM protected-execution checks. The cache-related logic relevant to T-041 (lines 280-283 and 355) is unchanged, so the SSD tier's at-rest posture, scope salting and kill switch are unaffected.

LaunchAgent.swift adds EngineV2Factory.prefillChunkKey and stepTokenBudgetKey to inferencePassthroughEnvKeys, plus doc comments. These are numeric scheduler-tuning variables forwarded from the operator's environment into the launchd job plist. The operator is already the local trust-boundary actor who controls the provider environment (TB-003). No secrets, endpoints, or attestation/authorization inputs are forwarded. The effect is availability or performance tuning of prefill geometry, and the existing partial-prefill cap and deadline admission remain.

Remaining questions for integration, not findings: (1) where PrefillGeometry is defined and how prefillChunkKey and stepTokenBudgetKey are parsed and bounded (for example, whether extreme values are clamped against memory admission). That code is outside the supplied evidence. (2) How the new prefillGeometry field is consumed by other callers (bridge, telemetry, benchmark readers). Nothing in the supplied evidence shows it being sent to the coordinator or exposed to consumers. No regression to the listed threat IDs was identified.
